outlook.statement: Priorities for FY 2026-27 include further strengthening service quality, enhancing guest engagement, increasing direct bookings, expanding Food & Beverage and MICE businesses and realizing the benefits of technology, sustainability and infrastructure investments.
Remain optimistic about the long-term prospects of both Chennai and the Indian hospitality industry.

The board of directors, in their meeting held on 28th May 2026, granted approval to exercise the Buy Option of the said property by the Company to the extent of its entitlement under the framework agreement. The Company is presently taking such further actions as may be necessary in accordance with the terms of the Framework Agreement.

The outlook for FY 2026–27 remains positive and optimistic. Demand is expected to remain strong across major segments, while disciplined supply addition should support healthy pricing. Focus on revenue optimization, customer experience, digital distribution, and cost efficiency is expected to sustain profitability.

borrowings.note: Long Term Rating CRISIL BBB /Stable (Reaffirmed); Short Term Rating CRISIL A3+ (Reaffirmed) as on 04th July, 2025

Secured by mortgage over Land and Building of the Hotel property at No. 365, Anna Salai, Teynampet, Chennai, hypothecation of entire movable fixed assets (excluding vehicles), pari passu charge on present and future current assets. Repayable in 158 monthly instalments at interest rate benchmarked with ICICI Bank Reference rate (current 8.4%). Charge created on movable assets w.e.f. 09.12.2025 in favour of Universal Trusteeship Services Limited up to INR 222.92 Cr. Further charge for working capital facility up to INR 5 Cr.

Loan assigned/transferred; outstanding as at 31st March 2025 was Rs. 10,602.91 lakhs. Secured by mortgage over same hotel property, hypothecation of movable fixed assets, pari passu charge on current assets. Charge modified w.e.f. 13.08.2024 for ceding first pari-passu charge to Aditya Birla Finance Limited for Rs. 50 Cr. Further modified for second pari passu charge in favor of Axis Bank Limited for overdraft facility of Rs. 5 Cr. Original loan Rs. 16,000 lakhs repayable in 180 monthly instalments at Axis Finance Reference Rate (current 10.45%). Rs. 5,000 lakhs assigned to Aditya Birla Finance Limited.

Assigned portion of Axis Finance Limited loan (Rs. 5,000 lakhs). Outstanding as at 31st March 2025 was Rs. 4,837.09 lakhs. Secured by same assets. ABFL has sole authority to receive and collect receivables under assigned assets.
